summary: The Southern Regulators (Mississippi, Arkansas and Louisiana commissions) answer in support of a motion by public interest organizations to move the comment deadline on MISO's Zero-Injection Generator Interconnection Agreement proposal from September 8 to September 15, 2026.
ask: Grant the public interest organizations' request to extend the ER26-3552 comment deadline from September 8 to September 15, 2026.

points.point: The Southern Regulators back a seven-day extension of the comment deadline, from September 8 to September 15, 2026.
points.quote: The PIOs request that the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (Commission) extend the comment deadline in this proceeding by seven days from September 8, 2026, to September 15, 2026.
